statement:
private theorem cellWeightedSum_eq
    (p : FinPMF U)
    (C₁ : InferenceDevice.{u, v} U) (C₂ : InferenceDevice.{u, v'} U)
    [DecidableEq C₁.Setup] [DecidableEq C₂.Setup]
    (x₁ : C₁.Setup) (x₂ : C₂.Setup) :
    (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun u : U => C₁.setup u = x₁ ∧ C₂.setup u = x₂)).sum
        (fun u => p.mass u * (boolPm (C₁.concl u) * boolPm (C₂.concl u))) =
      2 * agreeMass p C₁ C₂ x₁ x₂ -
        pushOnImage p (fun u => (C₁.setup u, C₂.setup u)) (x₁, x₂)

    (p : FinPMF U)
    (C₁ : InferenceDevice.{u, v} U) (C₂ : InferenceDevice.{u, v'} U)
    [DecidableEq C₁.Setup] [DecidableEq C₂.Setup]
    (hind : StatisticallyIndependent p C₁.setup C₂.setup)
    {x₁ : C₁.Setup} {a₂ b₂ : C₂.Setup}
    (hx₁ : 0 < setupMass p C₁ x₁)
    (ha₂ : 0 < setupMass p C₂ a₂) (hb₂ : 0 < setupMass p C₂ b₂)
    (hne₂ : a₂ ≠ b₂)
    (hall₂ : ∀ w : U, C₂.setup w = a₂ ∨ C₂.setup w = b₂) :
    condExpect p C₁.setup x₁
        (fun u => boolPm (C₁.concl u) * boolPm (C₂.concl u)) =
      2 * (cellAgreeProb p C₁ C₂ x₁ a₂ * setupMass p C₂ a₂ +
        cellAgreeProb p C₁ C₂ x₁ b₂ * setupMass p C₂ b₂) - 1

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.diffVoters_mem_iff
statement:
lemma diffVoters_mem_iff
    (Pbar Pbar' : Profile V A) (v₁ v₂ v : V) :
    v ∈ diffVoters (V := V) (A := A) Pbar Pbar' v₁ v₂ ↔
      v ≠ v₁ ∧ v ≠ v₂ ∧ Pbar.pref v ≠ Pbar'.pref v

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.diffVoters_updateProfile_eq_erase
statement:
lemma diffVoters_updateProfile_eq_erase
    (Pbar Pbar' : Profile V A) (v₁ v₂ v₃ : V)
    (hv₁ : v₃ ≠ v₁) (hv₂ : v₃ ≠ v₂)
    (hv : v₃ ∈ diffVoters (V := V) (A := A) Pbar Pbar' v₁ v₂) :
    diffVoters (V := V) (A := A)
        (updateProfile Pbar v₃ (Pbar'.pref v₃)) Pbar' v₁ v₂
      = (diffVoters (V := V) (A := A) Pbar Pbar' v₁ v₂).erase v₃

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.eq_singleton_iff_theWinner_eq
statement:
lemma eq_singleton_iff_theWinner_eq {V A : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.eq_topChoice_of_topRank
statement:
lemma eq_topChoice_of_topRank {V A : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.expandProfile_pref_of_ne
statement:
theorem expandProfile_pref_of_ne {V A : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq V]
    (v₁ v₂ : V) (hne : v₁ ≠ v₂) (P' : Profile {w : V // w ≠ v₂} A) {v : V} (h : v ≠ v₂) :
    (expandProfile v₁ v₂ hne P').pref v = P'.pref ⟨v, h⟩

statement:

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.expandProfile_updateProfile_eq
statement:
lemma expandProfile_updateProfile_eq {V A : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq V]
    (v₁ v₂ : V) (hne : v₁ ≠ v₂)
    (P' : Profile {w : V // w ≠ v₂} A)
    (w : {u : V // u ≠ v₂}) (hw : w.val ≠ v₁)
    (ballot : LinearOrder A) :
    expandProfile v₁ v₂ hne (updateProfile P' w ballot) =
    updateProfile (expandProfile v₁ v₂ hne P') w.val ballot

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.expandProfile_updateProfile_v1_eq
statement:
lemma expandProfile_updateProfile_v1_eq {V A : Type} [Fintype V] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq V]
    (v₁ v₂ : V) (hne : v₁ ≠ v₂)
    (P' : Profile {w : V // w ≠ v₂} A)
    (ballot : LinearOrder A) :
    expandProfile v₁ v₂ hne (updateProfile P' ⟨v₁, hne⟩ ballot) =
    updateProfile (updateProfile (expandProfile v₁ v₂ hne P') v₁ ballot) v₂ ballot

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.gs_base_case
statement:

name: _private.AISafetyAtlas.Upstream.GibbardSatterthwaite.0.SocialChoice.gs_base_case_unit

theorem gs_base_case_unit {A : Type} [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]

name: Finset.sum_eq_sum_zero_off_inter

name: Prob.exp_mono'
statement:
lemma exp_mono' {f g : Prob α} (u v : α → ℝ) (h : ∀ x, f.prob x * u x ≤ g.prob x * v x) :
    f.exp u ≤ g.exp v

name: Prob.exp_mul_const
statement:
lemma exp_mul_const (s : ℝ) (f : Prob α) (g : α → ℝ) :
    f.exp (λ x ↦ g x * s) = f.exp (λ x ↦ g x) * s

name: Prob.exp_nonneg
statement: lemma exp_nonneg {f : Prob α} {g : α → ℝ} (g0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ g x) : 0 ≤ f.exp g

name: Prob.le_exp_of_cut
statement:
lemma le_exp_of_cut {f : Prob α} {u : α → ℝ} (i : α → Prop) (a b : ℝ) (fi : a ≤ f.pr i)
    (iu : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → i x → b ≤ u x) (u0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → ¬i x → 0 ≤ u x)
    (b0 : 0 ≤ b) : a * b ≤ f.exp u

name: Prob.le_exp_of_forall_le
statement:
lemma le_exp_of_forall_le {f : Prob α} {u : α → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → b ≤ u x) :
    b ≤ f.exp u

name: Prob.le_pr_bind_of_cut
statement:
lemma le_pr_bind_of_cut {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {p : β → Prop} {i : α → Prop} (a b : ℝ)
    (fi : a ≤ f.pr i) (gp : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → i x → b ≤ (g x).pr p) (b0 : 0 ≤ b) :
    a * b ≤ (f >>= g).pr p

name: Prob.markov
statement:
lemma markov (f : Prob ℝ) (f0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ x) {a : ℝ} (a0 : 0 < a) :
    f.pr (λ x ↦ a ≤ x) ≤ f.mean / a

name: Prob.markov'
statement:
lemma markov' (f : Prob α) (g : α → ℝ) (f0 : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → 0 ≤ g x) {a : ℝ} (a0 : 0 < a) :
    f.pr (λ x ↦ a ≤ g x) ≤ f.exp g / a

name: Prob.mean_add
statement: lemma mean_add (f g : Prob ℝ) : (f + g).mean = f.mean + g.mean

name: Prob.mean_bind
statement: lemma mean_bind (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob ℝ) : (f >>= g).mean = f.exp (λ x ↦ (g x).mean)

name: Prob.mean_map
statement: lemma mean_map (f : α → ℝ) (g : Prob α) : (f <$> g).mean = g.exp f

name: Prob.mean_mul
statement: lemma mean_mul (f g : Prob ℝ) : (f * g).mean = f.mean * g.mean

name: Prob.mean_pure
statement: lemma mean_pure (x : ℝ) : (pure x : Prob ℝ).mean = x

name: Prob.mean_smul
statement: lemma mean_smul (s : ℝ) (f : Prob ℝ) : (s • f).mean = s * f.mean

name: Prob.mul_eq
statement: lemma mul_eq (f g : Prob ℝ) : f * g = do let x ← f; let y ← g; return x * y

name: Prob.neg_eq
statement: lemma neg_eq (f : Prob ℝ) : -f = do let x ← f; return -x

name: Prob.one_eq
statement: lemma one_eq : (1 : Prob ℝ) = pure 1

name: Prob.pr_and_const
statement:
lemma pr_and_const {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} {q : Prop} :
    f.pr (λ x ↦ p x ∧ q) = f.pr p * (if q then 1 else 0)

name: Prob.pr_bind
statement:
lemma pr_bind {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} (p : β → Prop) :
    (f >>= g).pr p = f.exp (λ x ↦ (g x).pr p)

name: Prob.pr_const
statement: lemma pr_const (f : Prob α) (p : Prop) : f.pr (λ _ ↦ p) = if p then (1:ℝ) else 0

name: Prob.pr_enrich
statement:
lemma pr_enrich {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {p : β → Prop} :
    (f >>= g).pr p = (f >>= (λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x)).pr (λ y ↦ p y.2)

name: Prob.pr_eq_add_of_cut
statement:
lemma pr_eq_add_of_cut {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} (q : α → Prop) :
    f.pr p = f.pr (fun x ↦ p x ∧ q x) + f.pr (fun x ↦ p x ∧ ¬q x)

name: Prob.pr_eq_one
statement: lemma pr_eq_one {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p = 1 ↔ ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → p x

name: Prob.pr_eq_prob
statement: lemma pr_eq_prob (f : Prob α) (y : α) : f.pr (λ x ↦ x = y) = f.prob y

name: Prob.pr_eq_zero
statement: lemma pr_eq_zero {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p = 0 ↔ ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → ¬p x

name: Prob.pr_false
statement: lemma pr_false {f : Prob α} : f.pr (λ _ ↦ False) = 0

name: Prob.pr_le_one
statement: lemma pr_le_one {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p ≤ 1

name: Prob.pr_lt_pr
statement:
lemma pr_lt_pr {f : Prob α} {p q : α → Prop} (le : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → p x → q x)
    (lt : ∃ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 ∧ ¬p x ∧ q x) : f.pr p < f.pr q

name: Prob.pr_map
statement: lemma pr_map {f : α → β} {g : Prob α} (p : β → Prop) : (f <$> g).pr p = g.pr (λ x ↦ p (f x))

name: Prob.pr_mem_Icc
statement: lemma pr_mem_Icc {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p ∈ Icc 0 1

name: Prob.pr_mono
statement:
lemma pr_mono {f : Prob α} {p q : α → Prop} (pq : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → p x → q x) :
    f.pr p ≤ f.pr q

name: Prob.pr_ne_zero
statement: lemma pr_ne_zero (f : Prob α) (p : α → Prop) : f.pr p ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 ∧ p x

name: Prob.pr_neg
statement: lemma pr_neg {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr (λ x ↦ ¬p x) = 1 - f.pr p

name: Prob.pr_neg'
statement: lemma pr_neg' {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : f.pr p = 1 - f.pr (λ x ↦ ¬p x)

name: Prob.pr_nonneg
statement: lemma pr_nonneg {f : Prob α} {p : α → Prop} : 0 ≤ f.pr p

name: Prob.pr_or_le
statement: lemma pr_or_le {f : Prob α} (p q : α → Prop) : f.pr (λ x ↦ p x ∨ q x) ≤ f.pr p + f.pr q

name: Prob.pr_pure
statement: lemma pr_pure {x : α} (p : α → Prop) : (pure x : Prob α).pr p = if p x then 1 else 0

name: Prob.pr_true
statement: lemma pr_true {f : Prob α} : f.pr (λ _ ↦ True) = 1

name: Prob.prob_bind_ne_zero
statement:
lemma prob_bind_ne_zero (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) (y : β) :
    (f >>= g).prob y ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 ∧ (g x).prob y ≠ 0

name: Prob.smul_eq
statement: lemma smul_eq (s : ℝ) (f : Prob ℝ) : s • f = do let x ← f; return s * x

name: Prob.zero_eq
statement: lemma zero_eq : (0 : Prob ℝ) = pure 0

name: Prob.average_le_max
statement: lemma average_le_max {p x y : ℝ} (m : p ∈ Icc 0 1) : x*p + y*(1-p) ≤ max x y

name: Prob.bayes
statement:
theorem bayes (f : Prob α) (a b : α → Prop) (b0 : f.pr b ≠ 0) :
    f.cond a b = f.cond b a * f.pr a / f.pr b

name: Prob.bayes'
statement: lemma bayes' (f : Prob α) (a b : α → Prop) : f.cond a b * f.pr b = f.cond b a * f.pr a

name: Prob.cexp_add
statement: lemma cexp_add {u v : α → ℝ} : f.cexp (λ x ↦ u x + v x) q = f.cexp u q + f.cexp v q

name: Prob.cexp_bind_le_of_cut
statement:
lemma cexp_bind_le_of_cut {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {u : β → ℝ} {q : β → Prop} (i : α → Prop) :
    (f >>= g).cexp u q ≤
      max ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cexp (λ y ↦ u y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ i y.1))
           ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cexp (λ y ↦ u y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ ¬i y.1))

name: Prob.cexp_congr
statement:
lemma cexp_congr {u v : α → ℝ} (uv : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x = v x) :
    f.cexp u q = f.cexp v q

name: Prob.cexp_const_mul
statement: lemma cexp_const_mul {s : ℝ} : f.cexp (λ x ↦ s * u x) q = s * f.cexp u q

name: Prob.cexp_eq_cexp_add_cexp
statement:
lemma cexp_eq_cexp_add_cexp (r : α → Prop) :
    f.cexp u q = f.cexp u (λ x ↦ q x ∧ r x) * f.cond r q +
      f.cexp u (λ x ↦ q x ∧ ¬r x) * (1 - f.cond r q)

name: Prob.cexp_eq_cexp_cexp
statement:
lemma cexp_eq_cexp_cexp (g : α → β) (h : ∀ x y, f.prob x ≠ 0 → g x = g y → (q x ↔ q y)) :
    f.cexp u q = (g <$> f).cexp (fun k ↦ f.cexp u (fun y ↦ g y = k))
      (fun k ↦ ∃ x, g x = k ∧ q x)

name: Prob.cexp_eq_exp
statement: lemma cexp_eq_exp (q1 : f.pr q = 1) : f.cexp u q = f.exp u

name: Prob.cexp_eq_zero
statement: lemma cexp_eq_zero (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x = 0) : f.cexp u q = 0

name: Prob.cexp_if
statement:
lemma cexp_if :
    f.cexp (λ x ↦ if p x then u x else 0) q = f.cexp u (λ x ↦ p x ∧ q x) * f.cond p q

name: Prob.cexp_le_of_forall
statement:
lemma cexp_le_of_forall {b : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x ≤ b) (b0 : 0 ≤ b) :
    f.cexp u q ≤ b

name: Prob.cexp_mono
statement:
lemma cexp_mono {u v : α → ℝ} (uv : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → u x ≤ v x) :
    f.cexp u q ≤ f.cexp v q

name: Prob.cexp_nonneg
statement: lemma cexp_nonneg (h : ∀ x, f.prob x ≠ 0 → q x → 0 ≤ u x) : 0 ≤ f.cexp u q

name: Prob.cexp_on_zero
statement: lemma cexp_on_zero (q0 : f.pr q = 0) : f.cexp u q = 0

name: Prob.cexp_pure
statement: lemma cexp_pure {x : α} : (pure x : Prob α).cexp u q = if q x then u x else 0

name: Prob.cexp_sum
statement:
lemma cexp_sum {s : Finset β} {u : β → α → ℝ} :
    f.cexp (λ y ↦ s.sum (λ x ↦ u x y)) q = s.sum (λ x ↦ f.cexp (u x) q)

name: Prob.cexp_zero
statement: lemma cexp_zero : f.cexp (λ _ ↦ 0) q = 0

name: Prob.cond_bind_le_first
statement:
lemma cond_bind_le_first {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} (p q : β → Prop) (i j : α → Prop)
    (pi : ∀ x y, f.prob x ≠ 0 → (g x).prob y ≠ 0 → j x → p y → q y → i x)
    (jq : ∀ x y, f.prob x ≠ 0 → (g x).prob y ≠ 0 → j x → q y) :
    (f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cond (λ y ↦ p y.snd) (λ y ↦ q y.snd ∧ j y.fst) ≤
      f.cond i j

name: Prob.cond_bind_le_of_cut
statement:
lemma cond_bind_le_of_cut {f : Prob α} {g : α → Prob β} {p q : β → Prop} (i : α → Prop) :
    (f >>= g).cond p q ≤
      max ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cond (λ y ↦ p y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ i y.1))
          ((f >>= λ x ↦ Prod.mk x <$> g x).cond (λ y ↦ p y.2) (λ y ↦ q y.2 ∧ ¬i y.1))

lemma PMF.bind_apply' (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (y : β) :

name: PMF.integrable_of_support_finite

name: PMF.prob_toProb
statement:

lemma Prob.bind_toPmf (f : Prob α) (g : α → Prob β) :

name: Prob.integrable_toPmf
statement:
lemma Prob.integrable_toPmf (f : Prob α) (u : α → ℝ) [MeasurableSpace α]

name: Prob.integral_toPmf_eq_exp
statement:
lemma Prob.integral_toPmf_eq_exp (f : Prob α) (u : α → ℝ) [MeasurableSpace α]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass α] : ∫ x, u x ∂(f.toPmf.toMeasure) = f.exp u
